capability.summary: Fetch a localized Wikipedia article summary
capability.description: Calls the language-specific MediaWiki REST summary endpoint for one URL-quoted page title. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Encyclopedic article-summary retrieval; not authoritative fact verification, full-page scraping, or general web search.

constraint.io_signature: Input: page title and optional language code; output: JSON envelope containing http_status and the MediaWiki summary response or HTTP error body. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: optional language subdomain code; wrapper default en
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://<lang>.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/<URL-quoted-title>; no revision, extract length, or page-content option
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
wrapper URL-quotes the title but does not locally parse or truncate the response
no auth, cache, or retry; language domain and current article content determine the result

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing the selected-language Wikipedia summary object, URL, and HTTP status.

intent_tags: look up an encyclopedic page by title and language
negative_intents: search arbitrary websites or verify facts against primary sources

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing the selected-language Wikipedia summary object, URL, and HTTP status.
